purpose: Produce meaningful complete authored units for later quality sampling without reading200whole novels or claiming PG marker envelopes are main prose.
baseline: Reuse reviewed exact PG chapter partition principles (standalone repeated headings, complete ordered sequence, source-specific front/end matter and closing anchors). Those old61Austen boundaries do not generalize automatically to other books.
phase1_metadata_only: After envelope diagnostic terminal proof, classify currently stored heading/contents/note/caption span hints, preserving every book/raw/envelope/family/catalog/current-version identity. Hints are proposals, not cuts or proof of semantic completeness. Freeze deterministic finite development source selection before reading text; keep all uncertain/negative books, no cleaner replacement.

phase2_bounded_source_discovery_proposal.body_duplication: None until independently reviewed source-bound candidate boundaries; raw source remains authoritative.
phase2_bounded_source_discovery_proposal.candidate_rule: A chapter or other authored section needs an unambiguous standalone heading in a body sequence, exact inclusive heading/start and next same-level boundary or positively identified authored ending. Do not take first Nwords/sentences, split fixed token counts, interpret a contents-list entry as chapter, discard print prefaces or treat every all-caps line as chapter.
phase2_bounded_source_discovery_proposal.reconciliation: Partition every original envelope byte into candidate complete units or explicit frontmatter/endmatter/notes/illustrations/unresolved sidecars, all absolute raw char/byte spans+SHA. Inverse exact; whole-book/family lineage and all rejected/uncertain components preserved. No preferred edition chosen and no unknown bytes dropped.
phase2_bounded_source_discovery_proposal.dependencies: Resolve in-source numbered/named note references to source-bound note components, distinguishing bibliography/citations from explanatory prose. Ambiguous/missing references, multilevel/part headings, contents echoes, open quotations or narrative continuation across candidate boundaries remain unit-level context holds. No guessed missing paragraphs or attachment contents.
phase2_bounded_source_discovery_proposal.development_review: Whole-read proposed first/last units and adjacent boundary context for each selected book, including counterexamples to heading rules. Approve reusable rule classes rather than per-page sentence crops. Then freeze a full300 unit-generation policy/version and obtain a separate once-only bounded pass with full per-book coverage before any probability-quality draw.
phase2_bounded_source_discovery_proposal.failure_policy: Unsegmentable books remain explicit whole-envelope/structural-uncertainty records; never silently omitted or replaced to improve quality rates. Short complete introductions/poetry/lists can be legitimate, while novels with no reliable chapter structure require a different declared unit policy or retain whole-book review cost.

fresh_review_gate: Only after complete final source-unit frame, rights/family/near/protected/split rules and final policy freeze may200uniform+200tokenweighted draws define acceptance evidence. Exclude previously content-reviewed units/hash ancestry from fresh-review population explicitly. Preserve book clustering and draw multiplicity; source group remains one PG narrative group. Development samples and language/token counts alone are not final M2 acceptance.
